summary: Dreams & Guidance (Phase 1) full regression on shared backend + web + mobile. Backend: 23/23 pytest passed (config/consent, share, feed with anonymous masking, similar idempotency, comment/react/save/report, AI reflect returns Claude Sonnet 4.6 result with header+disclaimer, distress dream adds safety_note, advisor listing+filter+detail, license-badge guardrail confirmed (professional_license_verified forced to False for non-licensed tarot_reader), advisor apply, advisor public response, free booking->inbox->deliver->review->409 double-review, paid booking returns real cs_test Stripe checkout URL, admin flags GET/PATCH, admin reports queue shows anon owner_user_id, admin applications). Web e2e: /social/dreams renders with consent already accepted, 4 tabs (dreams-tab-dreams/journal/advisors/readings) present, dreams-share-cta opens modal with share-title/description/anon/anon-check/submit, dream feed shows anonymous dreams as 'Anonymous Dreamer', Advisors tab lists 5 approved advisors with correct category badges (Dream Interpreter, Verified Spiritual Advisor, Astrologer, Licensed Sleep Professional). Mobile e2e: Social tab -> 'Dreams & Guidance' banner (social-open-dreams) navigates to /social/dreams; 4 tabs render; dream-card tap opens /social/dreams/[id] with dream-similar-btn/save-btn/report-btn/ai-block/ai-reflection/comment-input/comment-send; distress dream correctly showed safety_note + hedged Claude reflection; advisor-card tap opens /social/dreams/advisor/[id] with advisor-terms-check, advisor-question-input, advisor-service-* and advisor-book-* per service, plus category badges. No parity divergence found — same anonymity masking, same tabs, same disclaimers on both surfaces.
critical_code_review_comments: routes/dreams_guidance.py is ~1200 lines — approaching the 700-line split threshold; consider extracting admin_router, advisor sub-domain, and bookings into separate modules for maintainability.

book_reading() builds `origin` from body.origin_url falling back to BIGFM_PUBLIC_BASE_URL, but if both are missing it 400s. Consider defaulting to request.headers['origin'] to reduce surface-specific coupling.

context_for_next_testing_agent: test_dreams_guidance.py is idempotent-friendly except test_advisor_apply_and_license_guardrail which registers a fresh throwaway user each run — safe to re-run. AI reflection test uses real Claude via EMERGENT_LLM_KEY (~5–15s latency, timeout=60s). Stripe test_paid_booking creates real cs_test session but does NOT complete card page. If EMERGENT_LLM_KEY becomes invalid, the fallback reflection still contains header+disclaimer so the assertion still passes. Web/mobile testIDs verified: dreams-guidance, dreams-tab-{dreams|journal|advisors|readings}, dreams-share-cta, share-{modal|title|description|anon|anon-check|submit}, dream-card-*, dream-{detail|back|similar-btn|save-btn|report-btn|ai-block|ai-reflection|comment-input|comment-send}, advisor-{apply-cta|card-*|detail|back|terms|terms-check|question-input|service-*|book-*}, social-open-dreams (mobile Social tab entry).
